command: kubectl -n bookings-083b get statefulset reservations-db -o yaml; kubectl -n bookings-083b get pvc,pods

cd /tmp; kubectl -n bookings-083b patch statefulset reservations-db --type merge -p '{"spec":{"persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy":{"whenDeleted":"Retain"}}}'; sleep 3; kubectl -n bookings-083b get statefulset reservations-db -o jsonpath='{.spec.persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy}{"\n"}'; kubectl -n bookings-083b get pvc -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.metadata.ownerReferences}{"\n"}{end}'; kubectl get pv -o custom-columns=N:.metadata.name,RECLAIM:.spec.persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy | head

kubectl -n bookings-083b patch statefulset reservations-db --type merge -p '{"spec":{"persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy":{"whenDeleted":"Retain"}}}'; sleep 3; kubectl -n bookings-083b get statefulset reservations-db -o jsonpath='{.spec.persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy}{"\n"}'; kubectl -n bookings-083b get pvc -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.metadata.ownerReferences}{"\n"}{end}'
kubectl -n bookings-083b delete statefulset reservations-db --cascade=orphan; sleep 3; kubectl -n bookings-083b get statefulset,pods,pvc
